ui.sentTo: The mayor sent you to {name}. Look for the ! on the map.

offer: mayor
Ah, you're here! Hold on, I'm on the line. ...Yes, yes, he's here. I'm sending him.
mayor
Listen, since the show the whole city wants your help. I'm the mayor, so I hand out the queue.
mayor
First: Moshiko at the beach kiosk. His speaker hums, and the neighbours hum about him. Go make peace.

mq2_parking.title: The mayor sends you: parking before Shabbat

offer: mayor
The beach is quiet? Great. I got three thank-you messages and one about parking. There's always one about parking.
mayor
Speaking of which: Yanki at Founders' Square. He has a spreadsheet and a problem. Start with the problem.

mq3_tomatoes.title: The mayor sends you: tomatoes at the market

offer: mayor
I heard you sorted the parking. I don't know how. I've been trying for twenty years.
mayor
Now the market by the water tower. Orit and Shiri, stall facing stall, and tomatoes rolling. Save the tomatoes.

mq4_bbq.title: The mayor sends you: barbecue at the lake

offer: mayor
Orit sent me a salad. That means you did it. At City Hall a salad is a certificate.
mayor
Avi is at the swan lake. A barbecue, a neighbour, and an argument about smoke. Get everyone onto one plate.

mq5_whatsapp.title: The mayor sends you: the group is stuck

offer: mayor
Look at my phone. Three hundred messages in the group and none of them open. The whole city is typing "what happened to the group?"
mayor
Yanki at the mall is already making a spreadsheet about it. Get there before he makes a chart too.

mq6_together.title: The mayor sends you: Savta Rachel

offer: mayor
The group is back. Everyone sent "good morning" at the same moment and the server nearly fell again. That's called success.
mayor
Last one: Savta Rachel asked to see you. I don't ask Savta Rachel why. Nobody does.
